name: Sogni Comfy Worker
description: Run a Sogni Fast Worker on your rented GPU. Enter your Sogni API key and worker NFT ID, then monitor jobs, earnings, and settings in the Sogni dashboard.

variants.name: 24 GB GPUs — RTX 3090 / 4090
variants.description: General image, video, and audio catalog. Choose a host with 64 GB RAM, 1 TB disk, and NVIDIA driver R580 or newer.

variants.name: 32 GB+ GPUs — RTX 5090 / RTX PRO 6000
variants.description: MiniMax video/music and FlashVSR upscaling. Choose a host with 64 GB+ RAM, 500 GB disk, and NVIDIA driver R580 or newer; 128 GB RAM recommended for a 96 GB GPU.
